about.title: About Palm Beach County School District
about.content: The School District of Palm Beach County serves public school students across Palm Beach County. Districtwide calendar dates apply broadly, but individual schools and programs may publish additional testing, event, early-dismissal, or program-specific dates.

content: Emergency make-up days are scheduled at the Superintendent's discretion when additional instructional time is required. Check official district notices after a closure.
Individual schools may publish additional testing, early-dismissal, event, or program-specific dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does every Palm Beach County school follow exactly the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Districtwide dates apply broadly, but individual schools and programs may publish additional testing, early-dismissal, event, or program-specific dates.

districtFaqs.q: Can emergency closures change the Palm Beach County school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The district may schedule emergency make-up days when additional instructional time is required. Check official district notices after a closure.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Palm Beach County school calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Check the district's official calendar page, the current School Board-approved PDF, and notices from the assigned school or program.

relatedDistricts.name: Miami-Dade County Public Schools
relatedDistricts.reason: Florida's largest school district and Palm Beach County's closest major neighbor to the south. Miami-Dade and Palm Beach County have historically shared Spring Break timing, meaning families comparing the two districts will see similar break windows but different school start dates and instructional calendars.

relatedDistricts.name: Broward County Public Schools
relatedDistricts.reason: Located between Palm Beach County and Miami-Dade, Broward County Public Schools is the second-largest district in Florida. Broward and Palm Beach typically align on Spring Break, and families relocating along the South Florida coast — particularly around Boca Raton and Deerfield Beach near the county line — often compare the two districts.

relatedDistricts.name: Orange County Public Schools
relatedDistricts.reason: A large Central Florida district that serves the Orlando metro area. Useful for families comparing Florida school calendar structures or relocating between South Florida and the Orlando corridor.
